app_tagline: Ask your organization's documents and get answers with sources.
auth_login_subtitle: Use your account at your organization.
auth_mfa_description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
auth_enroll_description: Required for administrator accounts. Scan the code below with the authenticator app on your phone (for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator).
auth_enroll_qr_label: QR code for your authenticator app
auth_enroll_manual: If you cannot scan it, enter this key in the app manually:
auth_enroll_code_label: The 6-digit code shown by the app
auth_recovery_description: If you lose access to your phone, you can sign in with these codes. Each code works only once. Store them somewhere safe; this screen will not be shown again.
home_next: The knowledge base and chat will be added to this page.
